title: The Best of Raj Kapoor
description: The 10 essential Raj Kapoor-directed films, ranked by overall film quality, direction, cultural impact, music and lasting influence on Hindi cinema.
intro: The essential five, if you only watch five: Awaara, Shree 420, Mera Naam Joker, Sangam and Jagte Raho.

entries.why_it_ranks: Raj Kapoor's defining directorial achievement — a mixture of romance, social commentary, dream imagery and unforgettable music that became an international phenomenon.
Perhaps the purest expression of the Raj Kapoor worldview, balancing romance, humour and a sharp examination of poverty, ambition and corruption.
Initially unsuccessful but subsequently re-evaluated as Kapoor's intensely personal, ambitious and melancholy meditation on performance, love and loneliness.
A grand romantic triangle elevated by spectacular locations, tremendous music and an unusually complicated examination of friendship, jealousy and marriage.
A remarkably dark social satire in which one thirsty outsider exposes the hypocrisy and fear hidden inside supposedly respectable urban society.
The film that established the RK cinematic identity — romance, rain, yearning and music — and turned Raj Kapoor and Nargis into an iconic screen pairing.
Kapoor reinvented himself by introducing a youthful romantic style that became enormously influential on subsequent Hindi cinema.
One of his strongest later films, using mainstream romance to confront widowhood and oppressive social traditions.
His final directorial film combines memorable music and imagery with an allegory about innocence being corrupted by society.
Uneven but visually and musically distinctive, with Kapoor exploring his recurring conflict between physical appearance and inner beauty.
